title: SEED-Bench: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models

layout.note: Two unframed drawings side by side, separated by whitespace. At the left an isometric five-tier pyramid (L0 at the bottom, L4 at the top) tilted so that its left face carries model names and its right face benchmark names, a diagonal axis arrow along its left edge and a chevron band extending right from each tier; at the right a four-ring sunburst with a spiral-arrow centre.

lesson: Show a benchmark's scope twice: a tilted pyramid of capability levels whose faces carry the models and benchmarks of each level and whose side bands give the input and output modalities, and a sunburst that breaks the covered levels into parts, groups and leaf dimensions in one hue per part.
